bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to renovate the historic Old Central School in the city of Grand Rapids.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; OLD CENTRAL SCHOOL RENOVATION. +]

[+$3,800,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the city of Grand Rapids to preserve and renovate the Old Central School building. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to renovate the historic Old Central School in the city of Grand Rapids.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; OLD CENTRAL SCHOOL RENOVATION.

$3,800,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the city of Grand Rapids to preserve and renovate the Old Central School building.
additions: $3,800,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the city of Grand Rapids to preserve and renovate the Old Central School building.
